Donald Trump’s claims about stolen elections date back to the 2012 presidential election.

Trump blames stolen or rigged elections on voting machines changing votes, dead people and illegal immigrants voting, people voting multiple times, media lies, stolen or phony mail-in ballots, and more.
Trump raised concerns about mail-in ballots in 2016 and 2018, but began talking about them heavily in July 2020.
Mail-in ballots played a larger role in 2020 due to COVID-19.

The Trump campaign filed 22 election lawsuits on or after November 3, 2020, with two victories: getting a polling place to stay open an hour later, and stopping an extension for ballot curing in Pennsylvania.
Trump’s tweets are presented as he posted them, including any typos or capitalizations.
Since Twitter suspended Donald Trump’s account on January 8, 2021, the text of the tweets were verified using the website thetrumparchive.com.
